question: Show primary and secondary school attendance by block, year and sex. Allow the user to select the indicator (boys or girls) and the year. Include source sheet and table information.

view.title: School Attendance by Block, Year and Sex
view.note: Select the indicator (boys or girls) and the year to filter the chart. The chart shows attendance percentages for each block at both primary and secondary levels. The source sheet is "Attendance Report" and the source tables are "Table 1" (primary) and "Table 2" (secondary).

interpretation_guard.caveat: The file does not provide information on causes of attendance variations.
